Unlimited liability

Partnership

The written contract defining each partner's role and share

Corporation

Owner losses restricted to the amount invested
Shareholder
A person owning stock and therefore part of a corporation

The group elected by shareholders to oversee a corporation

A hybrid form giving liability protection with pass-through taxation

The right to operate a business using another company's name and system

A business owned and operated by the members it serves
